label: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge
notes: CMS: 'Starting July 1, 2026, Medicare will begin a short-term demonstration'; extended through December 31, 2027; 'Eligible beneficiaries will have a $50 copay.'
CMS: operates outside the Part D benefit; the Part D deductible does not apply, the copay does not count toward TrOOP, and there is no low-income subsidy.
CMS: in 2026 a single central processor handles prior authorization, claims and pharmacy payment.
wegovy.com: requires a standalone PDP or MA-PD plan and a prior authorization from the prescriber; CMS determines eligibility.
Clinical eligibility criteria (BMI and comorbidity thresholds) were not readable on cms.gov; secondary sources mention BMI >= 27 with a qualifying condition. Not asserted by DoseCost.
Beneficiaries already receiving Part D GLP-1 coverage for other indications are reported as excluded (Pharmacy Times, Jul 9 2026; secondary).
source_note: Dates and $50 copay read on cms.gov. Covered drug list read on wegovy.com (Wegovy pen and pill, all doses) and secondary sources (Zepbound KwikPen, Foundayo).
